How many customers are from India?.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country = 'India';

What is the total order quantity?.sql:
SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_order_quantity
FROM order_items;

What is the total revenue?.sql:
SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * products.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items
JOIN products
    ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id;

What is the most expensive product?.sql:
SELECT product_name, price
FROM products
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 1;

What is the cheapest product?.sql:
SELECT product_name, price
FROM products
ORDER BY price ASC
LIMIT 1;

What are the three most expensive produc.sql:
SELECT product_name, price
FROM products
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 3;

What are the two cheapest products?.sql:
SELECT product_name, price
FROM products
ORDER BY price ASC
LIMIT 2;

How many orders were completed by custom.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id)
FROM orders
JOIN customers
  ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE orders.status = 'Completed'
  AND customers.country = 'India';

Show the product ID and total units orde.sql:
SELECT
    product_id,
    SUM(quantity) AS total_units_ordered
FROM
    order_items
GROUP BY
    product_id;

Show the customer ID and number of compl.sql:
SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'Completed'
GROUP BY customer_id;

What is the completed order count?.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Completed';

What is the completed revenue?.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status = 'Completed';

What is the cancelled revenue?.sql:
SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * products.price) AS cancelled_revenue
FROM orders
JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
WHERE orders.status = 'Cancelled';

What is the average order value for comp.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(order_items.quantity * products.price) / COUNT(DISTINCT orders.order_id) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders
JOIN order_items
    ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id
JOIN products
    ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
WHERE orders.status = 'Completed';

Show the product ID, product name, and p.sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, price
FROM products
WHERE category = 'Electronics'
  AND price > 500;

Show the order ID and order date for com.sql:
SELECT order_id, order_date
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'Completed'
  AND order_date >= '2025-06-01'
  AND order_date <  '2025-07-01';

What are the names of customers from Ind.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT customers.customer_name
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.customer_id
WHERE customers.country = 'India'
  AND orders.status = 'Completed';
